title: TV shows no signal from Chromecast
shortDescription: Chromecast with Google TV powered but no picture.
fullDescription: Chromecast requires adequate USB-C power. Insufficient power (e.g., from TV USB) causes boot issues and no-signal symptoms. Always use the included AC adapter.
videoSearchQuery: Chromecast with Google TV no signal

faq.q: Can I use TV USB for power?
faq.a: Rarely works - use the included 1.5A adapter.

title: Voice Remote not pairing
fullDescription: Google TV Voice Remote uses Bluetooth. Fresh batteries and holding back+home for 10 sec resets pairing.

faq.q: Can I use phone as remote?
faq.a: Yes - Google Home or Google TV app.

title: Streaming buffers constantly
fullDescription: Chromecast 4K Max needs strong WiFi. Ethernet adapter ($25 Google) provides reliable option.

fixSteps.title: Google Ethernet adapter
fixSteps.instruction: Plug between USB-C and AC adapter.

faq.a: 4K Max has Wi-Fi 5; HD has older WiFi.

title: Google TV update hangs
fullDescription: Google TV update sometimes hangs at 'preparing'. Often the 8GB flash runs out of space - uninstall apps and retry.

title: Cannot cast from phone
shortDescription: Chromecast not discoverable in cast menu.
fullDescription: Requires same WiFi network and mDNS/multicast allowed. Guest or IoT networks often break discovery.

fixSteps.title: Same SSID
fixSteps.instruction: Both phone and Chromecast on main network.

fixSteps.title: Enable mDNS in router
fixSteps.instruction: Some routers disable mDNS/IGMP by default.

title: HDCP handshake fail
fullDescription: Chromecast with Google TV cannot establish HDCP with downstream chain. Usually cable or AVR in between.

faq.a: Premium High Speed or Ultra High Speed.

title: Low storage warning
fullDescription: Chromecast with Google TV 8 GB storage fills with apps and caches. Cannot install new apps until space freed.

faq.a: Possible via USB-C hub with OTG but limited support.

title: App crashes to home
fullDescription: Clear cache, then data, then reinstall in that order.
